questions.question: In Nehemiah's day, the Israelites made a sworn oath together. What did they commit to?

answers.text: Follow the Law of God given through Moses
Rebuild the walls of every city in Judah
Send yearly gifts to the king of Persia

questions.question: When Israel swore an oath to follow God's Law, only the men joined, and their wives and children did not. True or false?
In their oath, what did the Israelites promise about their sons and daughters and the people of the land?

answers.text: Their children would not marry the people of the land
Their children would not work for the people of the land
Their children would not visit the people of the land

questions.question: When the people of the land sold grain on the Sabbath, what did Israel promise in their oath?

answers.text: They would not buy from them that day
They would buy only what they needed
They would trade goods instead of paying
